author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Elon's universal high income is not feasible unless there is only one super AI under one world government. 

Here is a thought experiment, there are two countries, each with a more or less equivalent super AI.   

Country A has a universal high income, no one does any work, everyone is just dead weight to the super AI. 

Country B doesn't have universal high income, all humans are required to work, no matter how small the contribution is, to help make the super AI better. 

Guess which country will be able to take over the other country?  Which system will win?
